title: The planner's visual review asks for no image of a stock screen page group
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A page group of stock screens only asks for no image; a mixed group stands for its first page that is not a stock screen; V01 passes with every other image delivered.

tests: a page group of stock screens asks for no image; a mixed group stands for its first page that is not one
